purpose: Development comparisons; these four selected cases were used for selection and are not held-out evidence.
candidateChoice: pair-only with gas priced for the pinned zero-base-fee competition chain
selectionReason: Paired-only beat holding the starting basket in all four development cases. Correcting the gas model improved candidate P&L in three cases and reduced mined reverts from two to one. It still trails the starter in three cases; full coverage remains required.
limitations: Only calm, crash, cex-drift and whale seed 101 were used for development.
Market interactions and wall-clock ordering can change control returns between runs.
Paired bundles are independently funded but not atomic.
The disconnected local pilots were incomplete and are excluded.
